import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
L=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aas=L[0].split(); B62={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for a,v in zip(aas,p[1:]): B62[(p[0],a)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8); M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        r1=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(r1,s2[j-1])
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]); k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2); M[i,j]=c[k]+s; P[i,j,0]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go); k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2); X[i,j]=c[k]; P[i,j,1]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge); k=0 if c[0]>=c[1] and c[0]>=c[2] else (1 if c[1]>=c[2] else 2); Y[i,j]=c[k]; P[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]))); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=P[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');st=P[i,j,1];i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=P[i,j,2];j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
def mapres(ref,s,positions):
    a1,a2=nw(ref,s); ri=si=0; out={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-': ri+=1
        if c2!='-': si+=1
        if c1!='-' and ri in positions: out[ri]=c2
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-'); aln=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    return out, 100*ident/aln

ref=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0A6G3.json",headers=H,timeout=60).json()['sequence']['value']
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",headers=H,timeout=240,
    params={"query":'(xref:pfam-PF02464) AND (taxonomy_id:286)',
            "fields":"accession,organism_name,sequence","size":500,"format":"json"})
recs=r.json()['results']; link=r.headers.get('Link','')
while 'rel="next"' in link:
    nxt=re.search(r'<([^>]+)>; rel="next"',link).group(1)
    r=requests.get(nxt,headers=H,timeout=240); recs+=r.json()['results']; link=r.headers.get('Link','')
uniq={}
for x in recs: uniq.setdefault(x['sequence']['value'],(x['primaryAccession'],x['organism']['scientificName']))
P3298="MARDPVLAVLGYLKDHHLVLTTAESCTAGCMVALLAAFPGTGEVLESGYVVYSPSAKKRLLGVSAETIERYGLTSEPVAWEMALGALKDSDANVVIATTGLAGPDPASGVLPGTLCFAWAFAGEPTALFTRTQRFFGERAQVMHDGAVYGLTRLIHYHERWLRGERA"
P1628="MDPITTLATRLGEHLRRFNAQVTTAESCTGGGIAEAITRIPGSSAWFEAGYVTYSNAQKTRQLGVPEALFGQVGAVSQEVVEAMVRGAQAASGARFAVAVSGVAGPDGGSPAKPVGTVWLAWGDGDRVFSERRQFDGDREAVRRQTVIAALDGLLQLGAE"
def kmer(s,k=3): return collections.Counter(s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s)-k+1))
def cosim(c1,c2):
    ks=set(c1)|set(c2); v1=np.array([c1.get(x,0) for x in ks],float); v2=np.array([c2.get(x,0) for x in ks],float)
    return float(v1@v2/(np.linalg.norm(v1)*np.linalg.norm(v2)))
c3,c1k=kmer(P3298),kmer(P1628)
items=[(s,a,o,'PP_3298-like' if cosim(kmer(s),c3)>cosim(kmer(s),c1k) else 'PP_1628-like') for s,(a,o) in uniq.items()]
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); sub=[]
for cl in ['PP_3298-like','PP_1628-like']:
    pool=[x for x in items if x[3]==cl]
    idx=rng.permutation(len(pool))[:35]; sub+=[pool[i] for i in idx]
print("NW-aligning subsample n=",len(sub))
POS=[29,56,61,142]
rows=[]
for s,a,o,cl in sub+[(P3298,'Q88HQ5','Pseudomonas putida KT2440','PP_3298-like'),(P1628,'Q88ME5','Pseudomonas putida KT2440','PP_1628-like')]:
    mp,pid=mapres(ref,s,set(POS))
    rows.append(dict(acc=a,org=o,clade=cl,pct_id=round(pid,1),**{f"ec{p}{ref[p-1]}":mp[p] for p in POS}))
sc_df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("\nTetrad conservation (NW-aligned Pseudomonas subsample):")
for cl,g in sc_df.groupby('clade'):
    print(f"  {cl}  n={len(g)}  mean %id to E. coli PncC = {g.pct_id.mean():.1f}")
    for p in POS:
        col=f"ec{p}{ref[p-1]}"; print(f"    {col}: "+", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k,v in g[col].value_counts().items()))
sc_df['tetrad_intact']=sc_df.apply(lambda r:(r['ec29S'],r['ec56Y'],r['ec61K'],r['ec142R'])==('S','Y','K','R'),axis=1)
print("\nfraction with all four intact:\n", sc_df.groupby('clade').tetrad_intact.mean().round(3).to_string())
print("\nP. putida entries:\n", sc_df[sc_df.acc.isin(['Q88HQ5','Q88ME5'])].to_string(index=False))
sc_df.to_csv('pseudomonas_nw_tetrad.csv',index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax=axes[0]; lab=['S29','Y56','K61','R142']
for i,(cl,color) in enumerate([('PP_1628-like','#3b6ea5'),('PP_3298-like','#c4622d')]):
    g=sc_df[sc_df.clade==cl]
    fr=[(g[f"ec{p}{ref[p-1]}"]==ref[p-1]).mean()*100 for p in POS]
    ax.bar(np.arange(4)+(i-0.5)*0.36,fr,0.34,label=f"{cl} (n={len(g)})",color=color)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(lab); ax.set_ylim(0,108)
ax.set_ylabel("% of sequences keeping the\nE. coli PncC residue")
ax.set_title("Catalytic tetrad conservation across the two\nPseudomonas CinA_C paralog clades")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
ax=axes[1]
geo=pd.DataFrame([dict(name="A. fabrum PncC\n2A9S X-ray",d1=2.90,d2=3.82),
                  dict(name="E. coli PncC\nAF2",d1=3.09,d2=4.07),
                  dict(name="PP_1628\nAF2",d1=3.03,d2=4.27),
                  dict(name="PP_3298\nAF2",d1=2.87,d2=4.01),
                  dict(name="E. coli YdeJ\nAF2, no NMN\nbinding",d1=2.92,d2=np.nan)])
x=np.arange(len(geo))
ax.bar(x-0.19,geo.d1,0.36,label="Ser OG to Lys NZ",color='#3b6ea5')
ax.bar(x+0.19,geo.d2.fillna(0),0.36,label="Tyr OH to Arg CZ",color='#c4622d')
ax.text(4+0.19,0.3,"Tyr and Arg replaced\nby Phe67 and Cys152",ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=7,rotation=90)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(geo.name,fontsize=7.5)
ax.axhline(3.5,ls='--',c='grey',lw=0.8)
ax.set_ylabel("distance (angstrom)"); ax.set_ylim(0,5.2)
ax.set_title("Ser/Lys dyad and Tyr/Arg substrate pair geometry")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
